ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Flex - Plug-in mini smart speaker with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add Alexa in a hallway without taking up shelf space.

ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought a fourth-generation Dot, so this older model feels redundant.
